summary_md: **HeRenFor ([@herenfor](https://x.com/herenfor/status/2115818458181214472))** profiled a 9.7-hour DeepSeek Harness session (100 min blocked on background tasks, 79 min waiting after questions, 20 min of foreground sleep) and wrote plugins that background tasks with auto-wake, make questions non-blocking and keep tokens out of context, cutting conversation blocking from 20 to 5 minutes ([herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning)).
